channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Driverless Car in Motion? Bhopal Youth Climbs Onto Roof for Stunt, Arrested After Video Goes Viral
item.description: A youth from Bhopal was arrested and charged with rash driving after a viral video captured him performing a dangerous stunt on the roof of a moving car with no one in the driver's seat.

item.title: Five Family Members Found Dead Inside Locked House In Kasganj, Uttar Pradesh; Probe Underway
item.description: Police broke open a locked home in Amanpur, Kasganj, where five family members were found dead, with the cause under investigation.

item.title: Donald Trump Raises Global Tariffs From 10% To 15% After Court Setback, Escalating Trade Tensions Worldwide
item.description: President Donald Trump increased global tariffs by 5% a day after a major court ruling challenged his trade authority, prompting mixed reactions across markets and governments.

item.title: IDFC First Bank Hit By ₹590 Crore Fraud At Chandigarh Branch; Four Employees Suspected
item.description: Four IDFC First Bank employees stand suspended after a ₹590 crore fraud was detected in Haryana government-linked accounts at the Chandigarh branch.

item.title: Over 68,000 of 2.74 Lakh Missing Madhya Pradesh Women and Girls Still Untraceable, Govt Tells Assembly
item.description: Government data tabled in the Assembly shows that despite tracing over 2.35 lakh women since 2020, more than 68,000 remain unaccounted for, raising serious concerns about safety, trafficking risks and systemic gaps.

item.title: Nepal Bus Tragedy: 18 Dead After Pokhara-Kathmandu Bus Plunges 300 Metres Into Trishuli River In Midnight Crash
item.description: Bus carrying 40+ veered off Nepal’s Prithvi Highway, killing 18, injuring dozens.

item.title: Telangana: 20-Year-Old Fresher Found Dead in Medical College Hostel, Probe Underway
item.description: A first-year physiotherapy student from Peddapalli was found dead in her Siddipet college hostel, with police investigating the circumstances and campus wellbeing concerns emerging.

item.title: “First Woman In Our Family To Fly”: Son’s Heartwarming Gesture Melts The Internet
item.description: Manish's viral video of his mother's first-ever flight melts hearts nationwide.

item.title: CBSE 2026 Exams Under Legal Scanner: PIL Alleges Unequal Difficulty Across Multiple Question Paper Sets
item.description: A Public Interest Litigation questions whether CBSE’s multi-set exam system compromised fairness for lakhs of students in 2026.

item.title: People of Purpose: From a Childhood Dream of Justice to Building One Future Collective, Vandita Morarka’s Journey
item.description: Vandita Morarka, founder of One Future Collective, redefines justice through radical kindness, supporting communities and institutions in an infinity loop of lasting change.
